Title: LSJ- Remnant of the Endless Storm

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Remnant of the Endless Storm
Ally
Unique werewolf with 5 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed. Requires a magaji.
The Remnant gets +1 strength for each life it has. The Remnant may
enter combat with any minion as a (D) action. If any effect does more
than 2 damage to the Remnant, ignore the excess. If the Remnant has 4
or fewer life during your untap phase, it gains 1 life from the blood
bank.
6 pool

Are strikes included under effects?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. Everything that has any effect is included.

True.

"All strikes are effects (that is, yes 'strikes' are included under
'effects') ", which indeed covers the true fact that the strike with
Argent Baton is an effect.

Naturally, any effect, strike or otherwise, that does't do damage
won't do more than two damage and therefore won't be among the effects
covered under Remnant's text, but that doesn't mean the strike in
question is not included under "effects".
